rationale: The agent verified the user by matching the provided email to a single user ID before proceeding. It retrieved and presented addresses from the user’s past orders, allowed the user to choose the Washington, DC address, clearly listed the pending orders to be updated, and obtained explicit confirmation before making any changes. It then successfully updated the shipping addresses for all three pending orders only (not delivered/processed ones) and provided accurate confirmation afterward, consistent with tool outputs. While the initial scenario mentioned updating the default address as well, the user in the conversation requested only pending order address changes; the agent correctly limited actions to that confirmed request. No fabrication or policy violations observed.
